feeds.title: Coachella Valley Independent » Music
feeds.description: Take a closer look at Coachella Valley's musical industry with independent and objective news, music, arts, opinion, and commentary by the Coachella Valley Independent. Keep your information up-to-the-minute with the latest updates on the web. The Coachella Valley Independent is a local news publication and website covering the valley and state diligently.

feeds.title: Gay Desert Guide Palm Springs » Music
feeds.description: Get the information you need in the Gay Desert Guide about Coachella Valley and Desert Music Festivals, plus the latest news on music around the valley. Gay Desert Guide Palm Springs is the #1 resource for finding LGBTQ+ Palm Springs Gay Bars & Nightlife, Events, Dining, Businesses & Things to Do in Palm Springs

feeds.title: Coachella Valley Country Blog
feeds.description: Coachella Valley Country's blog brings pictures, stories, and events happening throughout the Coachella Valley, thereby introducing country music, its artists, and its history, to the Latino community. CVC is a media resource started by Country Music fans at Coachella Valley High School to connect underrated music talent to a wider audience.

feeds.title: The Orange County Register » Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
feeds.description: Peek inside Coachella's musical tapestry with the latest news and information about the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival brought to you by The OC Register. The Orange County Register is a prominent newspaper in the county providing coverage of various topics including politics, business, sports, entertainment, and more.

feeds.title: Eclectic Music Lover
feeds.description: Eclectic Music Lover, aka Jeff Archuleta, is a gay, Atheist, progressive liberal, and lifelong lover of music. Each week he posts his Top 30 favorite songs, and occasionally posts lists of favorite songs for a specific year or decade, or a particular theme of interest. He also enjoys discovering and supporting indie artists and bands, and promotes them by reviewing their music.

feeds.title: Palm Springs DJ Track Star Staci Blog
feeds.description: Go behind-the-scenes with Palm Springs DJ Track Star Staci, as she recounts a series of incredible performances, stories, and DJ hacks through her gigs. taci, a female Palm Springs turntable DJ specializing in corporate & luxury events. Her brand partners include Coca-Cola, Lamborghini, & Nike among others.
